exposure: caesarean section in the second stage of labor
outcome: extension of the lower uterine segment incision
cohort: 90 women who underwent caesarean section in the second stage of labor at Nilratan Sircar Medical College and Hospital, Kolkata, West Bengal, India from March 2020 to August 2021
finding: Caesarean section at full cervical dilatation is associated with a higher likelihood of adverse outcomes for both mother and fetus.
